description: Golden rule fixtures for the deterministic rule self-test (spec 10.10). Each case records the exact finding codes its engine must emit; a rule is covered when at least one case emits it (positive) and one case of the same engine does not (negative).

configuration.xdp_content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xdp:xdp xmlns:xdp="http://ns.adobe.com/xdp/">
  <template>
    <subform name="InvoiceForm" dataRef="$.Invoice">
      <field name="SupplierName">
        <bind match="dataRef" ref="$.Header.Name"/>
      </field>
    </subform>
  </template>
</xdp:xdp>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xdp:xdp xmlns:xdp="http://ns.adobe.com/xdp/">
    <template>
        <subform name="InvoiceForm" dataRef="$.Invoice">
            <field name="InvoiceNum">
                <bind match="dataRef" ref="$.Header.InvoiceID"/>
            </field>
            <field name="SupplierTax">
                <bind match="dataRef" ref="$.Header.Supplier.TaxNumber"/>
            </field>
            <field name="TotalAmt">
                <bind match="dataRef" ref="$.Header.TotalAmount"/>
            </field>
            <field name="ItemDescription">
                <bind match="dataRef" ref="$.Items.Item.ProductDescription"/>
            </field>
        </subform>
    </template>
</xdp:xdp>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xdp:xdp xmlns:xdp="http://ns.adobe.com/xdp/">
  <template>
    <subform name="InvoiceForm" dataRef="$.Invoice">
      <field name="InvoiceNum" presence="hidden">
        <bind match="dataRef" ref="$.Header.InvoiceID"/>
      </field>
    </subform>
  </template>
</xdp:xdp>
